task_context.message_text: Write a formal email to a project partner asking them to confirm whether they can attend a coordination meeting next Tuesday at 15:00.

sections.title: Opening
sections.purpose: State the purpose of the message

sections.title: Meeting Request
sections.purpose: Ask the recipient to confirm attendance for the coordination meeting

sections.title: Closing
sections.purpose: Close politely and invite a response

final_prose_output.text: Dear Partner, I hope you are well. I am writing to ask whether you would be available to attend a coordination meeting next Tuesday at 15:00. Please kindly confirm your availability at your earliest convenience. Kind regards.
